Still, it’s rare to find this collectible online — and Mattel hasn’t produced another Diwali doll since — so we recommend adding it to cart while it’s still in stock.

“In celebration of Diwali, Barbie and I are both encouraging fans around the world to celebrate the beautiful heritage of Indian fashion and culture,” Dongre said in a statement when the doll was first released. “My brand has always been driven by a mission to empower through fashion, and as the ultimate symbol of women empowerment, partnering with Barbie to create the Barbie Diwali doll couldn’t be a more perfect alignment of our values.”

If the Diwali doll is out of your budget, Barbie also makes this Indian-inspired doll. Part of Barbie’s “Fashionistas” collection, the doll features flowing brown hair and a turquoise snake print skirt and top with black strappy heels.

entertainment.title: Chris Pappas Becomes First Openly Gay Man Elected to Senate
entertainment.summary: Elsewhere in history-making results from the 2026 midterms, Keisha Lance Bottoms is the first Black woman ever elected governor.
entertainment.body:
Chris Pappas is set to become the first openly gay male U.S. senator, following his projected defeat of former U.S. Sen. John E. Sununu in New Hampshire.

The Democrat is the third openly LGBTQ+ person to be elected to the Senate, following former senators Tammy Baldwin and Kyrsten Sinema.

Pappas’ victory keeps the open Senate seat in Democratic control as Pappas and Sununu were facing off against retiring Democratic Sen. Jeanne Shaheen. After his win, Pappas told supporters it was a “victory for Team New Hampshire over the broken status quo,” per the Associated Press , calling it “a wake-up call for corporate special interests and billionaires who have been rigging the econom, for the cowards in Congress who have enabled health care cuts, tariffs and war and for the incompetent president who can’t even be bothered to care how people are being hurt.” But his win also makes a statement that reverberates far beyond one election . Related Stories Midterms 2026 Kathy Hochul's Win in New York Assures a Hollywood Home for Years to Come News Pedro Pascal, Olivia Rodrigo, Dave Bautista, Jennifer Lawrence Among A-Listers Urging Fans to Vote: "Get Out There"

Pappas’ win may also soon have a corollary in Hollywood: Andrew Scott , star of Simon Stone’s Elsinore , could this season become the first openly gay man to win a best actor Oscar. Only two others (Sir Ian McKellen and Colman Domingo) have even been nominated.

Pappas was far from the only candidate making history at the midterms Tuesday night. Michigan Democrat Abdul El-Sayed won his race and became the first Muslim to be elected to the U.S. Senate. Republican Byron Donalds also became Florida’s first Black governor on Tuesday, Democrat David Crowley became Wisconsin’s first-ever Black governor after his win over Tom Tiffany, and Democrat Keisha Lance Bottoms became the first Black woman ever to be elected governor in any state with her win in Georgia.

And with the Democrats taking control of the House, Hakeem Jeffries is poised to become the body’s first-ever Black Speaker.

This is part of The Hollywood Reporter’s ongoing midterm coverage. You can check out all of our pieces here .

entertainment.title: Diana Ross Sets One-Off Australia Concert
entertainment.summary: The Queen of Motown will headline the Sydney Summertime concert series next March for an exclusive, one-night-only concert.
entertainment.body:
Diana Ross will head to Australia next year for her first concert in these parts in more than two decades.

The Queen of Motown will headline the Sydney Summertime concert series on Friday, March 5, for an exclusive, one-night-only concert, presented on the eve of the Sydney Gay and Lesbian Mardi Gras Parade.

The superstar singer will bring Diana Ross Freedom in Motion to Centennial Park for the one-off spot, reads a statement from Black Peach Touring, the concerts promoter launched last year by Jessica Ducrou, co-founder and former CEO of Secret Sounds Group. Related The Lettermen's Tony Butala Dies at 87 Karol G Sweeps Latin Airplay's Top 3 With 'No Me Arrepiento de Sentir Tanto' Tracks Steve Ellis, Love Affair Singer, Dies at 76 Explore Diana Ross See latest videos, charts and news

“Diana Ross is an absolute icon and to have her choose Sydney Summertime for her only Australian show, one night only in Centennial Park, on the eve of Mardi Gras is exactly the kind of unforgettable moment we created this series for,” comment Ducrou and Elise Huntley, co-founders and directors of Black Peach, in a statement. “It’s going to be something very special.”

Ross is the third international headliner confirmed for Sydney Summertime’s inaugural 2027 season, following The Strokes and Kings of Leon. Joining the legendary U.S. artist on stage will be British electronic duo Groove Armada for a DJ set, with additional performers to be announced shortly.

The all-ages concert series is supported by Destination NSW, the lead agency for the visitor economy in the NSW government.

Ross, who boasts a string of hits as leader of the Supremes and as a solo artist, is “one of the most iconic performers in music history, with a career spanning decades and a catalogue of hits loved by generations of fans,” comments New South Wales minister for jobs and tourism Steve Kamper.

“To have an international superstar of her caliber headline at Sydney Summertime for an Australian-exclusive performance is a major coup for NSW,” adds Kamper. “Events like this are a powerful driver of tourism. They bring more visitors to our state, generating economic benefits for local businesses and jobs, and reinforce NSW’s reputation as a destination for world-class live music and entertainment.”

entertainment.title: Eminem’s ‘Not Afraid’ Featured in Abdul El-Sayed’s Election Day Campaign
entertainment.summary: Also: Common performed at the Michigan Senate candidate's last rally before voters made their pick on Tuesday (Nov. 3).
entertainment.body:
Eminem ‘s “Not Afraid,” the Billboard Hot 100 chart-topper from the rapper’s 2010 Recover y album, soundtracks one of Michigan Senate candidate Dr. Abdul El-Sayed’s latest campaign clips. The democrat released the video online early Tuesday morning (Nov. 3) as Election DAy kicked off.

“Michigan. It’s time. It’s up to us to show the country what’s possible,” El-Sayed wrote Tuesday in a social media post that featured the campaign video featuring the Eminem hit. “The world is watching.”

Eminem has not commented on El-Sayed’s usage of his song or publicly endorsed a candidate in the 2026 midterm election; The Detroit News reports he was not contacted by the campaign.

In 2024, Eminem made an appearance in Detroit in support of Kamala Harris , and in 2020, “Lose Yourself” was featured in a Joe Biden ad.

The rapper recently guested on track by fellow Detroit native Kid Rock, “Heal My Faith,” on which he raps about their years-long friendship and calls for unity across party and religious lines; Kid Rock has, of course, been outspoken about aligning with Donald Trump. Following the song’s release, Eminem noted, “Not about choosing sides, just choosing to make music with my old friend. Praying for all of us.”

As for El-Sayed’s current campaign, video footage posted online shows Common performed for the democratic candidate at a rally in Detroit on Monday night.

Michigan native Stevie Wonder also showed support for El-Sayed, getting on camera to voice his choice, as seen in a clip released on Election Day. “There is so much on the line this election,” Wonder says in the video. “We cannot be distracted … Go vote for Dr. Abdul El-Sayed for Senate, Jocelyn Benson for governor, and democrats down the ticket.”

Another artist who’s definitely in El-Sayed’s corner is Bruce Springsteen, who lent his endorsement on Monday.
